title: Director of Manufacturing Engineering & Technology
text:
**Director of Manufacturing Engineering - Aerospace CNC**
Bay Shore, NY (Onsite)
 
 
Lead a CNC manufacturing engineering team hands-on while modernizing the shop with machine connectivity, automation, and practical AI.
 
 
**Must-Haves**

* Significant manufacturing engineering experience in CNC machining, with recent hands-on problem solving
* Methodizing new work from drawings through production
* Strong CNC programming, cutting tools, workholding, and fixture design
* Reading drawings and GD&T
* Experience implementing CNC connectivity, automation, or digital manufacturing tools
* Leading technical teams while staying hands-on

**What You'll Do**

* Build routings, setups, tooling, fixtures, and work instructions for new work
* Support CNC programming, setup optimization, and floor troubleshooting
* Improve cycle times, tool life, throughput, and process capability
* Drive a roadmap for CNC digitization, automation, and AI tools
* Coach the engineering team and track scrap, downtime, and on-time delivery

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Aerospace or defense precision manufacturing
* BS in Manufacturing or Mechanical Engineering
* CAD/CAM, ERP/MRP, MES, and machine monitoring
* Capital equipment selection and ramp-up

**What You'll Get**

* $170K to $200K
* Leadership seat shaping the future of the shop

**About The Company**
An aerospace precision parts manufacturer on Long Island investing in modern CNC and digital manufacturing.
